feed.title: Daily engineering brief and The Merge Report
feed.subtitle: What an open-source monorepo built mostly by AI agents merged each day, for its engineering manager and for everyone else.

entry.title: Engineering brief, Monday, 19 October 2026
entry.summary: Good morning. This is the engineering brief for Monday, 19 October 2026: everything that merged to main between midnight and midnight UTC, and what needs you. 341 pull requests merged, 82% above the seven-day average of 187.6. Together they changed 15,747 files, adding 344,914 lines and removing 3,141. The work reached 49 products and 98 research projects. The headlines: 7 new products joined the catalogue, 96 new research projects started and 12 decisions still wait on the owner.

entry.title: The Merge Report, Monday, 19 October 2026
entry.summary: This is The Merge Report, coming to you live from the main branch of an open-source monorepo run mostly by AI agents. On Monday, 19 October 2026, the agents merged 341 pull requests into main. That’s one roughly every 4 minutes, around the clock, 82% above the seven-day average of 187.6.
